title: Diwali at Times Square Awards and Gala Dinner
description: The Diwali at Times Square weekend opens with an Awards and Gala Dinner honouring Indian American achievers in philanthropy, innovation, medicine and entrepreneurship.
long_description:
The Diwali at Times Square festival weekend begins on Friday evening, October 23, 2026, with an Awards and Gala Dinner at Tribeca 360 in Manhattan. The dinner honours Indian American contributions in philanthropy, innovation, medicine and entrepreneurship, according to organiser Sammaan For All.

The gala precedes the 11th edition of Diwali at Times Square on Saturday, October 24 — a free full-day festival on Broadway between 46th and 48th Streets with a Diwali Bazaar, cultural performances, the Diya Lighting Ceremony and the Light Up Times Square Concert.

Sponsors of the weekend include platinum sponsor Gopi, gold sponsor Xoom by PayPal, and the State Bank of India. Gala details and registration are on the official Diwali at Times Square website.
